title: Stdlib - Vector - 2 [Operations]
description:
## Vector Operations
Now that you can create vectors, you need to modify them.

- `vec.push_back(item)` - add to the end
- `vec.pop_back()` - remove from the end
- `vec.size()` - get the number of elements
- `vec[index]` - access by index
- `vec.at(index)` - access by index (with bounds checking)
- `vec.clear()` - remove all elements
- `vec.empty()` - returns true if empty

```cpp
std::vector<int> nums = {1, 2, 3};
nums.push_back(4);    // {1, 2, 3, 4}
nums.pop_back();       // {1, 2, 3}
std::cout << nums.size(); // 3
```
